summary: Canonical optional registry of stable repo-specific behavioral invariants (docs/INVARIANTS.json) consumed by /z-test, /z-execute, /z-review-all, and adaptive INTENT.

entry_points.summary: Schema v1 registry with 14 stable invariant entries (inv_001..inv_014).
Required fields, tag enum, severity enum (blocker/major/minor), source enum for each entry.
CLI validator: id uniqueness, tag-set subset, fixture_schema/defaults consistency, severity/source enums.
CI gate: runs tests, exits non-zero on uncovered blocker invariants or mandatory-test failure.

invariants: INVARIANTS.json is user-authored and optional; no generator exists; absence is normal and consumers fall back gracefully.
IDs are stable inv_NNN values (zero-padded 3-digit) and must not be reused; rename = new id + deprecate old.
Writes to the registry must be atomic (tempfile + fsync + os.replace()).
Tags must remain within the controlled set in docs/llm/TAGS.txt.
fixture_defaults requires fixture_schema and must validate against it.
severity must be one of blocker/major/minor; source must be one of spec/plan/user-concern/code-review/axiom-derived.
gotchas: Do not auto-generate invariants from vague prose.
Entry source_files inside the registry can drift independently from the invariant behavior it describes.
Current registry contains 14 entries, all severity blocker or major, all source=spec.

sighting_count/last_sighting/anchor_module are schema-declared as set by 'z-review-all Phase 5.5 on first match', but the actual Phase 5.5 in skills/z-review-all/SKILL.md accumulates tier2-context.json review patterns, not per-invariant sightings -- treat as reserved/forward-looking, not live.

/z-init-docs --invariants discovery and /z-maintain-docs source_files-mtime staleness detection are referenced in schema field descriptions but have no corresponding logic in skills/z-init-docs/SKILL.md or skills/z-maintain-docs/SKILL.md today.
